intro: Your bus is very late. Ask the conductor what has happened.

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: I am afraid the bus is running late today.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask why the bus is late.
expected: What has happened to the bus?

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: There is heavy traffic near the bridge.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask how long you will have to wait.
expected: How much longer is the wait?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Explain that you are worried about being late.
expected: I am worried because I will be late.
I am worried, I have to reach school.
I will be late for school.
conversation.hint: Try: "I am worried because I will be late."

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: I understand. There is another bus from the next street.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask whether that bus goes to your stop.
expected: Does that bus go to my stop?
Will that bus take me there?
Does it go the same way?
conversation.hint: Try: "Does that bus go to my stop?"

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: Yes, it does. Hurry and you will catch it.

conversation.speaker: student
expected: Thanks a lot for your help.
